text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Arima Kinen. Though
Narita
Brian is called the strongest, she
says it's all
because of my help.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Rising star Маяно Топ Ган and
recently
recovered Бива Хаяхидэ are
also racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With unwavering confidence, Narita
Brian boldly
goes to face her rivals!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
